# openwrt_network_rule6 (Resource)

An IPv6 policy routing rule (`config rule6`).

Manages a `rule6` section in `/etc/config/network`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.

### Optional

- `action` (String) Rule action. (UCI option `action`.) One of: `prohibit`, `unreachable`, `blackhole`, `throw`.
- `dest` (String) Destination subnet. (UCI option `dest`.)
- `disabled` (Boolean) Disable the rule. (UCI option `disabled`.)
- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `goto` (Number) Jump to the rule with this priority. (UCI option `goto`.)
- `in` (String) Incoming logical interface. (UCI option `in`.)
- `invert` (Boolean) Invert the match. (UCI option `invert`.)
- `ipproto` (String) IP protocol. (UCI option `ipproto`.)
- `lookup` (String) Routing table to look up. (UCI option `lookup`.)
- `mark` (String) Firewall mark (`mark/mask`). (UCI option `mark`.)
- `out` (String) Outgoing logical interface. (UCI option `out`.)
- `priority` (Number) Rule priority. (UCI option `priority`.)
- `src` (String) Source subnet. (UCI option `src`.)
- `suppress_prefixlength` (Number) Reject routing decisions with this prefix length or less. (UCI option `suppress_prefixlength`.)
- `tos` (Number) TOS value. (UCI option `tos`.)
- `uidrange` (String) UID range `start-end`. (UCI option `uidrange`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
